title: A coalition of 42 AGs opposes Character.AI's plan to auction off data from 21M+ US accounts, 2.1M+ registered to minors, saying the sale lacks user protections (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: A coalition of 42 AGs opposes Character.AI's plan to auction off data from 21M+ US accounts, 2.1M+ registered to minors, saying the sale lacks user protections — What happens to your private conversations when an AI company goes bankrupt? If it's Character.ai, apparently, the plan is to auction them off to the highest bidder.
